title: Cooper Is Modpack serverpack
description: This is the serverpack for Cooper Is Modpack.
body:
# Cooper Is Modpack — Server Pack A **minimal Fabric server pack for Minecraft 1.21.10**, containing only the essential logic and world-generation data required for the Cooper Is Modpack. ### **Short Summary** This pack is the backend foundation for your server. It ensures that world generation (biomes/structures) and gameplay mechanics (tree felling/mob drops) perfectly match the client experience while removing all heavy visual and UI mods to maximise Server TPS and stability. --- **🎯 Purpose** * **Parity:** Ensures clients see the same custom biomes and structures. * **Stability:** Stripped of all client-only rendering mods to prevent server crashes. * **Compatibility:** Pre-configured for multiplayer security and performance. --- **🧭 World Generation Parity** All required world-gen data is included, so the server handles terrain correctly: * **Dimensions:** Terralith, Incendium, and Nullscape. * **Structures:** All Dungeons & Taverns overhauls (Strongholds, Fortresses, Temples). * **Villages:** CTOV and Beekeeper Huts. --- **⚙️ Server-Side Mechanics** Core gameplay features handled by the server: * **FallingTree:** Server-side timber physics for all players. * **Right Click Harvest:** Agricultural quality-of-life for crops. * **Economy/Utility:** Rotten Leather recipes, Animal Feeding Troughs, and Mob Head drops. * **Mobs:** Friends and Foes logic for new mob spawns. * **Discord Integration:** Ability to chat between your Discord and Minecraft servers. --- **🛠️ Performance & Security** Tools to keep your server running smoothly: * **Spark:** Professional-grade profiling to diagnose and fix lag. * **Packet Fixer:** Prevents players from being disconnected due to large data packets. * **AuthMe:** Integrated security for player authentication. --- **🔗 Downloads** * [**Main Modpack:**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cooper-is-modpack/versions) (Client Modpack) * [**This Pack:**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cooper-is-modpack-serverpack/versions) (This Modpack) --- None of these mods are mine; full credit to all of the developers. ---
📦 Versioning & Release System **Version Format** `X.Y.Z` Example: - `1.2.4` - `2.0.1` **Version Numbers** - **X (Minecraft Update)** — incremented when the modpack updates to a new Minecraft version - **Y (Mod Additions)** — incremented when new mods are added to the pack - **Z (Mod Updates)** — incremented when existing mods are updated with no additions or removals **Mod Lists** Each release lists its exact mod set and changes in the Versions tab if you're looking for that.
